summary: The Hecke operators at two split places commute on spherical vectors; so do the polynomials in them.

steps.claim: On the underlying algebraic forms both sides are double sums Σ_{i,j} (−X)^i q_w^{…}(−Y)^j q_u^{…} T_{w,i} T_{u,j} y in the two orders; the operators T_{w,i} and T_{u,j} commute on forms spherical at w, w̄, u, ū (heckeSplit_comm, mem_sphericalAt), and the two double sums agree after exchanging the order of summation.
